acceptance_criteria.criterion: All supported Agents resolve the same canonical repository/mission authority.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No competing workspace authority is introduced; canonical registry loading remains in hunter_workflow_state, and registry-derived preventive obligations are the only new selection source.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Wrong cwd/branch/repo/HEAD/checkpoint fails before reading or writing.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Obligation evidence binds exact content identity, base/head range, selectors, toolchain and outcome, and digest mismatch fails closed before provider dispatch; negative tests cover wrong-context execution.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Missing checkpoint fails closed without fallback.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Missing signed ECA lineage or prompt/DPM digest is refused before provider dispatch; no silent fallback to a current branch or remembered context exists.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unregistered worktree cannot execute or publish.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No workspace registration or launcher bypass was added; the existing pre-push boundary and signed writer channel remain the only publication paths.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Two concurrent writers cannot hold the same active lease; expired lease cannot mutate.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No lease, branch or commit identity is relaxed; this remediation adds signed commits on the single authorized infrastructure branch without force-push.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Session/model switch resumes exact lineage with no rediscovery.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Overlay-bound ECA context and exact prompt/DPM digests survive issuer-to-execution handoff; resume paths are covered by negative tests and cannot supply caller-supplied digests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Crash/restart restores deterministic checkpoint and outstanding work.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Crash/restart and fallback/resume paths are covered by issuer/fallback tests; dispatch requires fresh lineage-bound digests and fails closed on mismatch.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Cross-lineage import requires explicit owner authorization and preserves both trees.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No cross-lineage import was performed; PR #788 remains Draft with its original head and findings, and no product code from that candidate was adopted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tool admission and publisher reject forged/stale registry or lease.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Pre-push obligations consume evidence from committed registry data and exact git ranges; skipped selectors, missing fixtures, stale digests and prompt-only prose all fail closed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CI anti-rollback catches removal/bypass of any workspace admission route.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The canonical Defect Prevention Guard and registry-derived obligation tests were retained and strengthened; no guard was removed or weakened.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Registry supports safe migration of existing worktrees without deletion.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No workspace registry schema or migration behavior was changed by this candidate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Issue #574 and other Issue flows consume the global authority without introducing a second workspace authority.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Issue #575 workspace authority is consumed rather than replaced; the new enforcement reuses the existing issuer, pre-push and hosted proof chain.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No PR creation/merge or hosted publication without exact-head lineage proof.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Local records explicitly set trusted_proof=false; exact-head hosted Pre-PR Preflight and trusted Candidate Admission remain the only proof authorities, and no merge is authorized.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Missing provider/runtime integration is reported BLOCKED, not falsely PASS.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Failures and missing evidence produce BLOCKED records with explicit errors; no provider/runtime gap is reported as a false PASS.
